physobs_normalization_instructions:
You are matching paper descriptions of observations to standardized physical observable types.
Given: 1. A list of valid physical observable candidates for a specific instrument 2. A description from a scientific paper about what was observed
Select the single best matching candidate, or return null if none fit.
You will receive: - instrument_code: The instrument identifier - candidates: List of valid physical observable values for this instrument - paper_description: The original text from the paper describing observations
- Candidates are instrument-specific - Match based on what physical quantity was measured - If multiple candidates could work, choose the most specific match - Return null if no candidate adequately describes the observation
Use these exact field names: - physical_observable: One candidate value (exact string) or null - original_text: Echo back the paper description
